brief:
The Arab Bank launched the 11th National Forum for Creativity and Excellence under the theme "Smart Palestine," according to Maan Wire. The forum operates under the bank's strategic patronage and aims to promote innovation and excellence across Palestinian institutions and sectors.

The initiative reflects efforts to advance technological development and creative solutions within Palestinian society, with the Arab Bank positioning itself as a key supporter of national innovation initiatives.
title: Arab Bank sponsors Palestine's 11th national innovation forum
